titles.romaji: Crayon Shin-chan: Bakuhatsu! Onsen Wakuwaku Daikessen
titles.english: Crayon Shin-chan: Explosion! The Hot Spring's Feel Good Final Battle
titles.native: 映画 クレヨンしんちゃん　爆発！温泉わくわく大決戦

description:
The Nohara family and "Onsen G-Men", the secret government agency maintaining all the hot springs in Japan, fight against "Yuzame", a bath-hating terrorist organization plotting to wipe out all the hot springs in Japan.

(Source Bilibili TV)
